title: Deluxe Desert Getaway, Heated Pool & Hot Tub
description: This upscale unit right near Old Town Scottsdale can fit up to 16 guests with its 6 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms. With its modern amenities, including a heated pool and hot tub, this home is perfect for those wanting to be right near everything Scottsdale has to offer. The professionally designed spaces offer open-concept layouts and kitchen & dining spaces perfect for entertaining.
review_snippets: This home is a guest favorite based on ratings, reviews, and reliability

I hosted my niece in law’s bachelorette trip at this home. It was absolutely perfect, almost brought her to tears since she didn’t know any of what we had planned. The home is so cute and clean. Plenty of space and the hosts were responsive, friendly and welcoming. We especially loved the outdoor space, perfect for playing music, watching a group movie and laughing by the pool. Grocery store and restaurants were close by and not far from phoenix.
Beautiful and spacious house for our Bachelorette Party of 9 women!

The house was perfect for our 8 guys golf trip. The backyard was great. The kitchen was well stocked and bedrooms were comfortable. Our only negative was the house needed to be cleaned better and couch cushions inside and out needed a deep cleaning. House looked exactly like pictures.
Very pretty property. Comfortable, spacious. Sadly the pool wasn’t heated and that wasn’t communicated. Worked with a very kind staff member who was able to give compensation.
